open_questions: Mass measurement needed to distinguish Saturn-mass planet from brown dwarf/small star given few Rjupiter size; spot-crossing/depth modulation still leaves unexplained variability to model but not required to reject planet
dossier.public_summary: TESS shows a 0.53-day, 1.5%-deep flat-bottomed dip exactly on the M dwarf with no odd-even or secondary eclipse and a ~6.5 Earth-radius size. The star’s strong 0.53-day spot modulation makes the depth and out-of-eclipse light variable, but a planet transiting a larger star explains the shape and size as well as a spot artifact, with a contaminating blended binary strongly disfavored.

reasons.why: Difference imaging puts the dip on the target and rules out all stars within 1 TESS pixel (21 arcsec) that could produce the 16570 ppm dip with <=25% eclipse, even the closest could-cause star at 28.7 arcsec is >26 sigma from the centroid.
reasons.value: verdict on_target offset 2.433 arcsec err 1.197 arcsec sigma 2.032; neighbours.plausible_within_1px 0 could_cause_within_1px 0 closest 28.7 arcsec sigma_from_centroid 26.6

reasons.why: Transit is strongly flat-bottomed, central impact parameter ~0, no odd/even depth change and no secondary eclipse; 6.6 Rearth sub-Neptune / Jupiter size remains planet-sized (Gaia radii 0.515/0.511 give 7.45/7.39 Rearth outside stellar regime) so a binary is not required by size or shape.

reasons.why: Duration is long for the TIC dwarf but fits the larger Gaia radius (1.48-1.49 <=1.5 central), with fit_log_density_ratio -1.479 and star_density_penalty_share 0.5819 explained by radius revision, so duration does not demand a binary and does not create stellar size.
reasons.value: TIC rad 0.4539 duration_ratio 1.678 vs Gaia FLAME 0.5151 duration_ratio 1.48 Gaia GSP-Phot 0.5112 duration_ratio 1.49

reasons.why: Star is an M dwarf (Teff 3431 K, VARIABLE flag) that varies strongly at the same 0.532 d period (amplitude >> depth) and shows large out-of-eclipse modulation (65% of depth, chi2 1006) — the best 0.15 ingress and negative V shape v_sigma -8.199 are inconsistent with a pure spot artifact, unlike a detrending-induced false positive; sector depths appear to change only because spot crossings modulate depth (changes_within_a_source p_constant 0.00021114624029681882 for SPOC 2-min, QLP p_constant 0.7018862753800172) and not because the signal jumps between apertures.
